entries.title: PS5SX2 (PlayStation 2)
entries.description: Native PS2 emulator based on PCSX2, build 2.10. Manual install: this ZIP contains TWO folders, PPSA99203/ for /data/homebrew/ and PCSX2/ for /data/. Requires kstuff, ShadowMount+, one PS5SX2 helper ELF, and your own PS2 BIOS and games. Do not treat this as a single-folder auto-installer.

entries.title: PS5SX3 (PlayStation 3)
entries.description: Experimental user-hosted PS5SX3/RPCS3 PlayStation 3 emulator build, v7.1 (.7z). Release notes say a PS3 update file was added; archive contents and redistribution permissions have not been independently verified. Title ID PPSA99303 may conflict with other homebrew. Requires ShadowMount+ and a separate helper ELF.

entries.title: PICO-8 PS5
entries.description: PICO-8 launcher for PS5. Requires a separately purchased/licensed Linux PICO-8 copy; the commercial PICO-8 binaries are not included.

entries.title: Ruffle Flash PS5
entries.description: Flash / SWF emulator. ALSO requires separately loading the upstream helper.elf with kstuff. SWF content is not included.
